queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: Terms to look up. What is done with them is defined by the endpoint layer.

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Hard stop on records pushed to the dataset. 0 means no limit.

fullRescan.title: Full rescan (ignore what was already collected)
fullRescan.description: Off by default: each run returns only records that are new or whose numbers changed since last time. Turn on to re-collect everything.

forceRefresh.title: Force refresh (ignore cached responses)
forceRefresh.description: Off by default: repeat calls inside an endpoint's TTL are served from cache. Turn on to hit Pinterest for every request — slower and more exposed, but guaranteed live.

vaultPlatform.title: Vault platform key
vaultPlatform.description: Which pool of sessions to draw from. Leave as 'pinterest' unless you keep several.
